cards.card_text: Then the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite meets Jeroboam on the road out of Jerusalem, wrapped in a new cloak.
cards.verse_text: During that time, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met Jeroboam on the road as he was going out of Jerusalem.
cards.snippet: During that time, the prophet Ahijah the Shilonite met Jeroboam on the road as he was going out of Jerusalem.

cards.card_text: That turn of events fulfills the word the LORD had spoken to Jeroboam through Ahijah the Shilonite, a prophet who tore a new cloak into twelve pieces and told Jeroboam to take ten (1 Kings 11:29-31).
cards.verse_text: So the king did not listen to the people, and indeed this turn of events was from the LORD, to fulfill the word He had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.
cards.snippet: …word He had spoken to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah the Shilonite.

cards.card_text: The rest of Solomon's acts, from beginning to end, are written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite and the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat, a man who served Solomon (1 Kings 11:26).
cards.verse_text: As for the rest of the acts of Solomon, from beginning to end, are they not written in the Records of Nathan the Prophet, in the Prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the Visions of Iddo the Seer concerning Jeroboam son of Nebat?
